SELECT r.experiment_id AS "experimentId", r.status AS "status", r.stop_requested AS "stopRequested", r.pause_kind AS "pauseKind", r.pause_reason AS "pauseReason", COALESCE(e.island_id, 0) AS "islandId" FROM experiment_run r JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.id = r.experiment_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = #{runId}
FOR UPDATE OF r, e
mapper.update: UPDATE experiment_run SET control_state = 'PAUSING' WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'running' AND control_state = 'PAUSE_REQUESTED' AND pause_requested_at IS NOT NULL AND pause_requested_at < now() - (#{staleSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval

UPDATE experiment_run SET status = 'paused', control_state = 'NONE', pause_requested_at = NULL, paused_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'queued' AND control_state IN ('PAUSE_REQUESTED', 'PAUSING')
UPDATE experiment_run SET stop_requested = true WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'running'

UPDATE experiment_run SET status = 'aborted', stop_requested = true, finished_at = now(), error = COALESCE(error, '人工停止') WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'aborted', 'cancelled')

UPDATE experiment_run SET status = 'queued', stop_requested = false, error = NULL, pause_kind = NULL, pause_reason = NULL, paused_at = NULL, control_state = 'RESUMING',
pause_requested_at = NULL,
finished_at = NULL WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status IN ('paused', 'failed', 'queued')

UPDATE run r SET status = 'aborted', actual_end = now() FROM experiment_run_step s WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.run_id = r.id AND s.experiment_run_id = #{experimentRunId} AND s.status = 'paused' AND r.status = 'paused'
